about_the_game:
Ahoy, cabin boy! I am Captain Morgan the Mcnifico himself, the best and most powerful pirate captain that has ever sailed the seas of 'Seek And Sail'. Don't you know me? That must be remedied!

The crazy people at Lamaglama have created a card roguelike that will make you lose more hours than my treasure chest has coins (and believe me, there are a lot of them). In this game, you mix strategy and luck to face powerful pirates, freshwater fanatics and monstrous sea creatures that would make the Kraken himself tremble... though he and I are old friends.

Each game is a unique adventure. You build your deck, paws and you never know what monster or treasure awaits you on the horizon. Maybe you'll run into me on the high seas? I hope you're prepared to lose HAHAHAHAHA!

Best of all is the humor. These developers have a sense of irony sharper than my saber. They've broken the fourth wall so many times that I don't even know if we're in a game or a tavern telling stories anymore.

What does 'Seek And Sail' offer?

  • Strategic card-based combat: Test your wits and prove yourself worthy of sailing with me.

  • A pirate world full of humor and irony: Nothing is what it seems here, except my greatness of course.

  • Monstrous sea creatures: From enchanting mermaids to monsters that will make you wish you had learned to swim.

  • A roguelike experience: No adventure is the same as the previous one. The roguelike is for landlubbers.

  • Colorful graphics and immersive music: You'll feel the salty wind in your face without leaving your cabin.

So, what are you waiting for to join the crew, or would you rather stay in port counting coins and missing out on the fun?

Come on, buy 'Seek And Sail' now and embark on the funniest and craziest adventure of the wild seas!

See you on the high seas, if you survive the first encounter with the monster of the deep - good luck, cabin boy!
